title: bench_repro.match_facts pairs no paraphrase of one fact, so duplicate research and dup_facts miss differently worded duplicates
goal: Two facts on one article citing one source that state the same thing in other words are paired by match_facts (or the duplicate counter's own matcher), so duplicate_research and dup_facts count them; until then dup_facts is a lower bound. Found by the SP-n7f53pgv review (S2 on ST-f5lbn3aw, whose check stubs match_facts).

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_repro as R
f=lambda t:{'path':'public/x/y.md','text':t+' [DOC S-aaaa]','at':1.0,'ids':['S-aaaa'],'doc':['S-aaaa']}
m=R.match_facts([f('The export job sends 512 records in each request and retries a failed batch three times.')],[f('Each export request carries up to 512 records; a failed batch is retried three times.')])
print(m);sys.exit(0 if m else 1)
